question: As of November 2020, who among the following was the President of the International Olympic Committee?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thomas Bach**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• International Olympic Committee is a **non-profit independent international organization** founded in the year 1894.
 
• Based in **Lausanne, Switzerland**, the Olympic Capital is entirely privately funded.
 
• **Thomas Bach **(As of September 2022 ) is currently the president of the International Olympic Committee.
 
• The International Olympic Committee is the patron of the Olympic Games and the leader of the Olympic Movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The Olympic Games originated in **ancient Greece** and were an intrinsic part of religious celebrations.
 
• It was held in **Olympia, Greece, in honour of Zeus** (the supreme god of Greek religion).
 
• The first modern **Olympics took place in Athens in 1896 and featured 280 participants from 13 countries in 43 events**.
